entries.title: Trump says US to scale back military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
entries.snippet: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

entries.title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
entries.snippet: The rare meeting comes a week after Israel rejected Donald Trump's peace plan for Gaza.

entries.title: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
entries.snippet: Moscow also launched deadly strikes against Ukraine overnight, sparking fires across the capital Kyiv.

entries.title: Two dead and hundreds evacuated after twin fires break out on Greek island
entries.snippet: About 200 firefighters worked to keep the fires from converging on Salamina, with one now under control.

entries.title: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum
entries.snippet: The works were taken overnight without alarms being triggered, raising suspicion of a professional hit.

entries.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
entries.snippet: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 53 people killed.

entries.title: US commander says mental health a 'priority' on USS Lincoln
entries.snippet: Adm Brad Cooper acknowledged that navy service at sea for long periods is "uniquely challenging and tough", following a visit to the warship.

entries.title: Teen suspect in Virginia campus shooting found hiding in closet
entries.snippet: The attack left five injured outside a halls of residence, and the suspect was not a student there, say police.

entries.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
entries.snippet: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

entries.title: About 100 homes swept away after Hurricane Lala lashes Hawaii
entries.snippet: The state's governor says there "amazingly" does not seem to have been any loss of life besides a car crash.

entries.title: Europe's tallest Virgin Mary statue unveiled in rural Poland
entries.snippet: The 55.6-metre (182ft) concrete figure is head-and-shoulders above Rio de Janeiro's Christ the Redeemer.

entries.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
entries.snippet: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.

entries.title: Belgian wildfire doubles in size on third day tearing through nature reserve
entries.snippet: Hundreds of firefighters are trying to contain the flames consuming the major park.

entries.title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta, reports say
entries.snippet: Security had been stepped up amid suggestions on social media of a second mass crossing on Saturday.

entries.title: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne
entries.snippet: The declaration was made on the national day of the central European country, which has a population of just 44,000.

entries.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
entries.snippet: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

entries.title: Australian state to launch gun buyback after Bondi Beach attack
entries.snippet: New South Wales, where the attack took place, will offer gun owners cash to give up their firearms.

entries.title: Family stranded at sea for 16 hours after jet ski capsized in Thailand
entries.snippet: A father and his two young sons spent a night adrift before being rescued off the coast of the island of Koh Samui.

entries.title: BBC seeks to subpoena family members in Panorama lawsuit
entries.snippet: A spokesperson for Trump's legal team responded to the request accusing the broadcaster of "seeking to harass" the president's family.

entries.title: Thailand has a gun problem - 10 million of them
entries.snippet: Recent shootings have highlighted the country's troubled relationship with guns, with laws doing little to curb the violence.

entries.title: Multiple people dead as flooding continues in Indiana
entries.snippet: Some parts of Indiana received more than 11 inches of rainfall over three days, beginning Aug. 11, causing record floods. Several suburbs of Indianapolis also underwater.

entries.title: Kushner meets with Hamas on the Gaza road map ahead of talks with Netanyahu
entries.snippet: Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law, held a rare meeting with Hamas leadership Sunday in Egypt, in a new diplomatic effort to make progress in the stalled Gaza ceasefire.

entries.title: Tommy John, namesake for a pioneering elbow surgery that saved his career, dies at 83
entries.snippet: The left-handed MLB pitcher was 31 years old when he tore the ulnar collateral ligament in his pitching elbow in 1974, an injury that had been a death knell for pitchers' careers up to that point.

entries.title: A good – and bad – week for Italy's art police and museum security
entries.snippet: On Friday, Italian police said they'd recovered three paintings stolen from a museum near the city of Parma. By Saturday night, thieves in Sicily had made off with four more masterpieces.

entries.title: Lala is again a tropical storm, sending drenching rain and winds across Hawaii
entries.snippet: Hurricane Lala weakened to a tropical storm Sunday after skirting Hawaii without making landfall, but it wasn't done punishing the Big Island with hurricane-force gusts.

entries.title: What really happened in Ceuta? Why we may never find out
entries.snippet: Hundreds of migrants have again attempted to cross from Morocco into the Spanish territory of Ceuta. This time, Moroccan officials fended them off, raising new questions about the crossing of July 30.

entries.title: 'What are we going to do?' The mom of a trans teen grapples with Trump's Medicaid move
entries.snippet: A longtime Republican living in California says the Trump administration's continuing actions to target transgender youth take a personal toll.

entries.title: Ukraine launches one of its largest aerial attacks of the war, killing at least 6 people in Russia
entries.snippet: Ukraine launched hundreds of drones across Russia Sunday, killing at least six people in one of Kyiv's largest aerial attacks of the war.

entries.title: NPR Senior Podcast Challenge: Official Rules
Billions of sea stars have died. A Northwest tribe is trying to save the species
entries.snippet: Sunflower sea stars are critically endangered in the Pacific Ocean. University of Washington researchers are working with the Samish Indian Nation to bring this 24-armed creature back from the brink of extinction.

entries.title: Firefighters battle massive wildfires in Belgium and Greece as 2 die on an island near Athens
entries.snippet: A blaze in eastern Belgium burned about 12 square miles in the High Fens, a large nature reserve, in one of the country's worst wildfires in recent history.

entries.title: Trump orders Pentagon to scale back joint exercises with South Korea
entries.snippet: Trump said in a social media post that the exercises slated to begin this week are costly and "send a signal that is totally inappropriate and hostile" to North Korea, which he said "has been unthreatening and respectful" while Trump has been in the White House.

entries.title: Lake Powell hits record low, threatening key water and electricity supply for millions
entries.snippet: The alarming milestone at Lake Powell comes about a week after the river's other major reservoir, Lake Mead, also hit a historic low.

entries.title: Fact-checking claims about Taylor Farms' donations to Trump-aligned groups
entries.snippet: Social media users looked into donations the company and its leadership made and drew assumptions about how those influenced the Trump administration's outbreak response.

entries.title: Colombian president asks Trump to suspend tariffs to help earthquake recovery
entries.snippet: De la Espriella took office earlier this month just days before the 7.4 magnitude quake struck.

entries.title: Moroccan security forces arrest nearly 300 migrants trying to reach Spain's Ceuta
entries.snippet: The latest attempt comes two weeks after tens of thousands of would-be migrants, driven by poverty and misinformation, rushed toward Ceuta in one of the deadliest migration crises to hit the region.

entries.title: Chronic pain is missing from America's heat warnings
entries.snippet: The results of a new study suggest that chronic pain deserves a place in how the country prepares people for extreme weather. They also show that rural residents may be the least protected.

entries.title: Kushner has rare meeting with Hamas' leader on Gaza road map. A meeting with Netanyahu is next
entries.snippet: The talks aim to salvage the new 15-point, U.S.-backed road map for Hamas to disarm in Gaza and Israel to withdraw from the Palestinian territory shattered by war.

entries.title: At least 7 people have died from days of heavy rain and record-setting flooding in Indiana
entries.snippet: A 4-year-old boy, two men and three women were among those who had died since the storms began Aug. 11, said Liz Woods, a spokesperson for the state Department of Homeland Security.

entries.title: Republicans won the redistricting competition. Don't tell that to this California congressman
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump last year told GOP-controlled states to redraw their maps before this year's midterm elections to increase the number of winnable seats for Republicans in order to help the party hold onto the U.S. House.

entries.title: Thieves steal 4 Renaissance artworks in a Sicilian museum heist during an Italian holiday
entries.snippet: Art expert Alberto Fiz estimated the value of the stolen works at 70 million euros ($81 million) to 80 million euros ($92 million).

entries.title: Rescuers in Indonesia recover more bodies in earthquake aftermath, raising death toll to 53
entries.snippet: More than 900 homes were destroyed and 450 more damaged in East Nusa Tenggara province, forcing about 5,000 people into temporary shelters.

entries.title: Ukraine launches one of its largest aerial attacks of the war, killing at least 6 people in Russia
entries.snippet: Kyiv has stepped up its attacks on Russia this year, with long-range missiles and swarms of drones targeting military industries and energy facilities.

entries.title: Lala is again a tropical storm, sending drenching rain and winds across the Hawaiian islands
entries.snippet: A search-and-rescue mission was launched after flash floods apparently swept several occupied homes off their foundations in coastal communities, authorities said.

entries.title: Cyclospora spreads through human waste — so how did it get on food?
entries.snippet: The nationwide cyclospora outbreak is very likely a result of sewage contamination in the food supply, according to scientific researchers and public health officials.

entries.title: Indiana authorities say at least 5 people have died as severe weather crosses the state
entries.snippet: The state has been hammered over the past week by heavy rains, resulting in rivers reaching record levels and sending residents in search of higher ground.

entries.title: Democrats' 2028 presidential calendar gives Black and Latino voters and union members an early say
entries.snippet: The primary lineup pushes Iowa from the traditional top spot and makes South Carolina the leadoff state, voting on Jan. 22, 2028, followed by Nevada on Feb. 1.

entries.title: UK's leader calls for reflection after the death of former Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism
entries.snippet: Jason Arday, who became Cambridge's youngest Black professor in 2023, was found dead inside an address in south London on Friday.

entries.title: While Taliban leaders mark 5 years in power in Afghanistan, a UN official warns of a rights crisis
entries.snippet: The Taliban seized power on Aug. 15, 2021, as the U.S. and other NATO troops withdrew following a costly two-decade war. The U.S. withdrawal led to chaos at Kabul airport as crowds of people tried to flee the country in desperation.

entries.title: U.S. pulls last aircraft carrier in Asia as Trump focuses on Iran and the Western Hemisphere
entries.snippet: The USS George Washington is departing the Pacific and expected to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln in the Middle East amid growing concerns about mental health and supply issues aboard the long-deployed carrier.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: UAE, Saudi Arabia, others condemn Israel's rejection of Trump Gaza plan
entries.snippet: The statement came as US envoy Jared Kushner and Gaza peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov held ceasefire and implementation talks with regional mediators and Hamas in Egypt.

entries.title: Ukraine attacks Wildberries, Russia's biggest online market
entries.snippet: Since mid-July, Ukraine has been targeting warehouses of Russia's largest online retailer Wildberries almost every day. Ukraine says it's disrupting front-line shipments. But experts say it's disrupting Russia's economy.

entries.title: Hundreds flee as Belgium battles wildfire at German border
entries.snippet: A rapidly spreading wildfire has scorched about 2,700 hectares in the High Fens nature reserve near Belgium's border with Germany. The German town of Monschau has also warned residents of possible evacuation orders.

entries.title: Ukraine launches one of its largest attacks of war
entries.snippet: Russia says hundreds of drones targeted Moscow overnight, with six fatalities in the capital and southern Rostov region. Five people were killed in strikes across Ukraine.

entries.title: Bus crash in Hungary kills at least 12
entries.snippet: Police say they have arrested the driver of a bus that crashed in Hungary, killing at least 12 people. The bus was carrying Polish pilgrims, media report.

entries.title: Troops from North Korea to boost Russia's Ukraine forces
entries.snippet: Intelligence agencies report that North Korea is preparing to send up to 50,000 troops to Russia. But military experts doubt this will make a fundamental difference in the course of Russia's war with Ukraine.

entries.title: US: Hurricane Lala brings Hawaii heavy rain, strong winds
entries.snippet: The Category 1 storm passed over Hawaii's Big Island without making landfall and is gradually weakening. However, the hurricane caused roads to flood and turned rivers into raging torrents.

entries.title: Africa's low-key high-stakes Strait of Hormuz diplomacy
entries.snippet: African governments have kept a low profile on the international stage during the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz. But that doesn't mean they haven't been engaging with the issue behind the scenes.

entries.title: How Germany supports recovery of Berlin Pride attack victims
entries.snippet: After a terrorist attack, public attention tends to focus primarily on the perpetrator. But what about the victims? What support can they expect? And what lies ahead for them?

entries.title: Iran war: Qatar denies holding missing Iranian fighter pilots
entries.snippet: Tehran said the three pilots "were captured alive" by Qatari forces after their fighter jets were shot down in the early days of the US-Israel war with Iran. Qatar has denied Iran's claims.

entries.title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to enter Spanish North African exclave Ceuta
entries.snippet: The attempted crossings come two weeks after around 72,000 people rushed into the Spanish North African exclave from Morocco. Calls for another mass crossing had been circulating on social media this week.

entries.title: Lebanon says 11 killed in Israeli airstrikes
entries.snippet: Lebanon's prime minister denounced the attacks on villages in southern Lebanon for targeting civilians in their homes. Israel said it was firing on Hezbollah infrastructure.

entries.title: In Germany, record heat meets climate action fatigue
entries.snippet: Climate action does not seem to be a priority for the German government — despite record temperatures, heat-related deaths and drought. Why aren't more people taking to the streets in protest?

entries.title: Hawaii under state of emergency ahead of historic hurricane
entries.snippet: A hurricane is forecast to hit the Big Island of Hawaii this weekend, bringing heavy rain and wind. Should it make landfall, Lala would be the first hurricane to hit the island since 1871.

entries.title: Russians snap up new homes built on Ukraine 'graveyard'
entries.snippet: Russia is constructing high-rises in the occupied Ukrainian city of Mariupol, on the sites of buildings it destroyed. Who's buying these properties? And what happened to the Ukrainians who used to lived here?

entries.title: Afghan allies still waiting for the safety Germany promised
entries.snippet: After the Taliban retook power on August 15, 2021, Berlin promised to bring Afghan staff to Germany. But people are still waiting to leave in Pakistan and Afghanistan.

entries.title: Trump's Latin America allies open arms to Israel
entries.snippet: While ongoing military actions in Gaza and settler attacks on Palestinians in the occupied West Bank have largely isolated Israel globally, Latin America's authoritarian right sees an opening for a strategic alliance.

entries.title: India: Modi promises free exam coaching, AI training for youth after protests
entries.snippet: Speaking on India's Independence Day, PM Modi announced free online coaching for competitive exams and AI training for 10 million youths, weeks after protests over alleged exam paper leaks and recruitment irregularities.

entries.title: Germany: Evacuated villagers return after Eifel wildfire eases
entries.snippet: Most residents evacuated from the village of Gey have returned home after firefighters brought a major wildfire in Germany's Eifel region largely under control. DW has more.
